# Exchange Online Hardening Kanban

Board updated: 2026-09-17 (Coworker-7, MDO-006-A4 Done; MDO-006 Done)
Source: Implementation Plan supplied 2026-09-17
WIP limit: 1 In Progress card per coworker; maximum 10 concurrent coworkers

Conventions:

- `Owner` holds the claiming coworker identity, or `unassigned` when the card is free.
- A card with ID `<ID>-A` is the empirical assertion for `<ID>`, and `<ID>` depends on it. A decomposed unit uses `<ID>-A1`, `<ID>-A2`, and so on.
- Each assertion card covers all negative tests for its unit plus exactly one positive test, written in Arrange-Act-Assert order.
- A card moves to Done only with a recorded passing verification command.

## Activity Log

- 2026-09-17: Coworker-7 completed MDO-006-A4 and MDO-006. All 18 assertions were red on `Test-SafeDocumentsControl` not being recognized - the fourth time on this board that the control registry has named a function the shipped surface does not carry, and this time the function was never written at all rather than merely unexported, so `MDO-005` Safe Documents was collected and then decided by nobody. The evaluator takes the `SAFEDOCS` entitlement verdict as a parameter instead of reading it out of the ATP policy, because an unlicensed tenant and a licensed tenant that switched Safe Documents off report the identical policy; a verdict reached on any plan other than the one the baseline declares is refused rather than accepted, so MDO P2 can never stand in for `SAFEDOCS`. `NotEntitled` decides `NotApplicable`, an unresolved preflight decides `Error`, and the scanner switch and the bypass allowance are each compared in both directions so neither can carry the other. Exported from both `Export-ModuleMember` and the manifest's `FunctionsToExport`. Verification: `Invoke-Pester -Path 'samples/contoso-exchange-online-managed-service/tests' -Output Normal` => Passed: 1377, Failed: 0.
